say: You can pay by: • Online — card or bank transfer at medicount.patientwallet.com • Phone — automated payment line 866-552-5484 (check-by-phone/ACH) • Mail — check to the payee address printed on your invoice Our fax number is 513-527-0657. Review any card or processing fees on the secure payment page before you confirm, and a returned check-by-phone payment carries a $25 fee (or as allowable by law).
